content: {"like":["Values historical context in monster films like Pulgasari’s North Korean production","Prefers up-to-date dinosaur science in series such as Planet Dinosaur","Enjoys classic Toho epics included in collections","Appreciates well-preserved original versions over dubbed cuts in Godzilla 2000","Enjoys strong chemistry and humor in 1960s spy series like The Man from U.N.C.L.E."],"dislike":["Dislikes CGI that undercuts practical monster suits in Return of the Killer Shrews","Dislikes poorly executed special effects in modern disaster films like Beginning of the End","Dislikes defective DVD/Blu‑Ray sets that fail to play, as with Kolchak – The Night Stalker","Dislikes shortened, dumbed‑down US dubs that omit plot points in Godzilla 2000","Dislikes low‑quality extras that fail to enhance the viewing experience"]}
